theorem eq_or_mem_of_mem_cons {a b : α} {l : List α} :
    a ∈ b :: l → a = b ∨ a ∈ l := List.mem_cons.mp

-- This pattern may be excessively general:
-- it fires anytime we ae thinking about membership of lists,
-- and constructing a list via `cons`, even if the elements are unrelated.
-- Nevertheless in practice it is quite helpful!
grind_pattern eq_or_mem_of_mem_cons => b :: l, a ∈ l

theorem mem_cons_self {a : α} {l : List α} : a ∈ a :: l := .head ..

theorem mem_concat_self {xs : List α} {a : α} : a ∈ xs ++ [a] :=
  mem_append_right xs mem_cons_self

theorem mem_append_cons_self : a ∈ xs ++ a :: ys := mem_append_right _ mem_cons_self

theorem eq_append_cons_of_mem {a : α} {xs : List α} (h : a ∈ xs) :

  induction xs with

@[simp, grind ←] theorem nil_sublist : ∀ l : List α, [] <+ l
  | [] => .slnil
  | a :: l => (nil_sublist l).cons a

@[simp, grind ←] theorem Sublist.refl : ∀ l : List α, l <+ l
  | [] => .slnil
  | a :: l => (Sublist.refl l).cons₂ a

theorem Sublist.trans {l₁ l₂ l₃ : List α} (h₁ : l₁ <+ l₂) (h₂ : l₂ <+ l₃) : l₁ <+ l₃ := by
  induction h₂ generalizing l₁ with
  | slnil => exact h₁
  | cons _ _ IH => exact (IH h₁).cons _
  | @cons₂ l₂ _ a _ IH =>
    generalize e : a :: l₂ = l₂' at h₁
    match h₁ with
    | .slnil => apply nil_sublist
    | .cons a' h₁' => cases e; apply (IH h₁').cons
    | .cons₂ a' h₁' => cases e; apply (IH h₁').cons₂

attribute [simp, grind ←] Sublist.cons

theorem sublist_cons_self (a : α) (l : List α) : l <+ a :: l := (Sublist.refl l).cons _

  (sublist_cons_self a l₁).trans

@[simp, grind =]
theorem cons_sublist_cons : a :: l₁ <+ a :: l₂ ↔ l₁ <+ l₂ :=
  ⟨fun | .cons _ s => sublist_of_cons_sublist s | .cons₂ _ s => s, .cons₂ _⟩

theorem sublist_or_mem_of_sublist (h : l <+ l₁ ++ a :: l₂) : l <+ l₁ ++ l₂ ∨ a ∈ l := by
  induction l₁ generalizing l with
  | nil => match h with
    | .cons _ h => exact .inl h
    | .cons₂ _ h => exact .inr (.head ..)
  | cons b l₁ IH =>
    match h with
    | .cons _ h => exact (IH h).imp_left (Sublist.cons _)
    | .cons₂ _ h => exact (IH h).imp (Sublist.cons₂ _) (.tail _)

  | .cons₂ _ s, _, .tail _ h => .tail _ (s.subset h)

  | .ite _ c t f => containsOldExpr c || containsOldExpr t || containsOldExpr f

/--
Get a list of original global variable names that are referred to in an
`old(...)` expression. Note that `expr` below should be normalized by
`normalizeOldExpr`.
-/
def extractOldExprVars (expr : Expression.Expr)
  : List Expression.Ident := match expr with
  | .const _ _ | .bvar _ _ | .fvar _ _ _ | .op _ _ _ => []
  | .abs _ _ e => extractOldExprVars e
  | .quant _ _ _ tr e => extractOldExprVars tr ++ extractOldExprVars e
  | .app _ e1 e2 => match e1, e2 with
    | .op _ (CoreIdent.unres "old") _, .fvar _ v _ => [v]
    | .op _ (CoreIdent.unres "old") _, _ => panic! s!"Old expression {expr} not normalized"
    | e1', e2' => extractOldExprVars e1' ++ extractOldExprVars e2'
  | .ite _ c t e => extractOldExprVars c ++ extractOldExprVars t ++ extractOldExprVars e
  | .eq _ e1 e2 => extractOldExprVars e1 ++ extractOldExprVars e2

/--
Substitute `old(var)` in expression `e` with `s`.
-/
def substOld (var : Expression.Ident) (s e : Expression.Expr) :
  Expression.Expr :=
  match e with
  | .const _ _ | .fvar _ _ _ | .bvar _ _ | .op _ _ _ => e
  | .abs m ty e' => .abs m ty (substOld var s e')
  | .quant m qk ty tr' e' => .quant m qk ty (substOld var s tr') (substOld var s e')
  | .app m e1 e2 =>
    match e1, e2 with
    | .op _ (CoreIdent.unres "old") _, .fvar _ x _ =>
      -- NOTE: We rely on the typeChecker to normalize `e` ensure that `old` is
      -- only used with an `fvar`.
      if x == var
        -- substitute, if should be substituted
        then s
        else e
    | _, _ => .app m (substOld var s e1) (substOld var s e2)
  | .ite m c t f => .ite m (substOld var s c)
                      (substOld var s t) (substOld var s f)
  | .eq m e1 e2 => .eq m (substOld var s e1) (substOld var s e2)

/--
For each `(var, val)` in `sm`, substitute `old(var)` in expression `e` with
`val`.
-/
def substsOldExpr (sm : Map Expression.Ident Expression.Expr) (e : Expression.Expr)
  : Expression.Expr :=
  if sm.isEmpty then e else
  match e with
  | .const _ _ | .fvar _ _ _ | .bvar _ _ | .op _ _ _ => e
  | .abs m ty e' => .abs m ty (substsOldExpr sm e')
  | .quant m qk ty tr' e' => .quant m qk ty (substsOldExpr sm tr') (substsOldExpr sm e')
  | .app m e1 e2 =>
    match e1, e2 with
    | .op _ (CoreIdent.unres "old") _, .fvar _ x _ =>
      match sm.find? x with
      | some s => s
      | none => e

import subprocess,sys,os,re
W=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
P="/localhome/milikic/proof-reduction-competition/.proof-eval-projects/strata-v4.26.0"
PRE=open(os.path.join(W,'prelude.lean')).read()
HDR="""#hb open OldExpressions in
theorem zz :
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
"""
patA=re.compile(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.\'!?]*|\d+|\"[^\"]*\"|.")
def strip(s):
    s=re.sub(r'--.*','',s); return re.sub(r'/-.*?-/','',s,flags=re.S)
def ntok(b): 
    b=strip(b); return len([x.group(0) for x in patA.finditer(b) if not x.group(0).isspace()])
def run(body,label=''):
    code=PRE+"\n"+HDR+body+"\nend CallElimCorrect\n"
    fn=os.path.join(W,'_b.lean'); open(fn,'w').write(code)
    try:
        r=subprocess.run(['bash','-lc',f'cd {P} && timeout 300 lake env lean {fn}'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=320)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return (label,'TIMEOUT',None,ntok(body),'')
    out=(r.stdout or '')+(r.stderr or '')
    m=re.search(r'HB=(\d+)',out); hb=int(m.group(1))/1000 if m else None
    bad=re.search(r'error',out)
    return (label,'OK' if not bad else 'FAIL',hb,ntok(body),out)
if __name__=='__main__':
    for f in sys.argv[1:]:
        body=open(f).read()
        res=run(body,os.path.basename(f))
        print(res[0],res[1],'HB',res[2],'tok',res[3])
        if res[1]!='OK': print(res[4][:1500])

159: /--
160: Get a list of original global variable names that are referred to in an
161: `old(...)` expression. Note that `expr` below should be normalized by
162: `normalizeOldExpr`.
163: -/
164: def extractOldExprVars (expr : Expression.Expr)
165:   : List Expression.Ident := match expr with
166:   | .const _ _ | .bvar _ _ | .fvar _ _ _ | .op _ _ _ => []
167:   | .abs _ _ e => extractOldExprVars e
168:   | .quant _ _ _ tr e => extractOldExprVars tr ++ extractOldExprVars e
169:   | .app _ e1 e2 => match e1, e2 with
170:     | .op _ (CoreIdent.unres "old") _, .fvar _ v _ => [v]
171:     | .op _ (CoreIdent.unres "old") _, _ => panic! s!"Old expression {expr} not normalized"
172:     | e1', e2' => extractOldExprVars e1' ++ extractOldExprVars e2'
173:   | .ite _ c t e => extractOldExprVars c ++ extractOldExprVars t ++ extractOldExprVars e
174:   | .eq _ e1 e2 => extractOldExprVars e1 ++ extractOldExprVars e2
175: 
176: /--
177: Substitute `old(var)` in expression `e` with `s`.
178: -/
179: def substOld (var : Expression.Ident) (s e : Expression.Expr) :
180:   Expression.Expr :=
181:   match e with
